metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: TABTUQ crystallizes in the orthorhombic crystal system with space group P n a 21. Reported CIF formula moiety: C128 H122 Lu9 O58 1+,0.3(C1 H4 O1),Cl1 1-,0.75(C3 H6 O2). From the CIF bond table, Lu1 (Lu) has 9 O neighbors; Lu21 (Lu) has 8 O neighbors; Lu22 (Lu) has 8 O neighbors; Lu31 (Lu) has 8 O neighbors; Lu32 (Lu) has 8 O neighbors; Lu33 (Lu) has 8 O neighbors; Lu41 (Lu) has 8 O neighbors; Lu42 (Lu) has 8 O neighbors; Lu43 (Lu) has 8 O neighbors; Lu5 (Lu) has 8 O neighbors; Lu61 (Lu) has 8 O neighbors; Lu62 (Lu) has 8 O neighbors; Lu63 (Lu) has 8 O neighbors; Lu71 (Lu) has 8 O neighbors; Lu72 (Lu) has 8 O neighbors; Lu8 (Lu) has 8 O neighbors; Lu91 (Lu) has 8 O neighbors; Lu92 (Lu) has 8 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 81 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 0.053-5.129 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 0.47-172.00°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C128 H122 Lu9 O58 1+,0.3(C1 H4 O1),Cl1 1-,0.75(C3 H6 O2). Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 2 μ4-OH (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)), 8 μ3-OH (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
